ai_summary: Aksharchem (India) Limited has notified shareholders of its 37th Annual General Meeting on September 22, 2026, providing online access to the FY2025-26 Annual Report and sending physical notices to those without registered emails. Materially, the Board has recommended a ₹0.50 per equity share dividend for FY2025-26, subject to AGM approval, and is urging shareholders to update KYC details to facilitate electronic dividend payments and enhance digital communication. No immediate red flags are identified; the document primarily concerns routine regulatory compliance and shareholder engagement.
